Enabled.Label: Enable Effects
Enabled.Hint: Apply shader effects to this tile.

Shader.Label: Shader
Shader.Hint: The shader effect to apply to this tile.

Intensity.Label: Effect Intensity
Intensity.Hint: The strength of the shader effect.

Color.Label: Effect Color
Color.Hint: The color of the effect. An empty value gives the default color of the selected effect.

Speed.Label: Animation Speed
Speed.Hint: The speed of the effect animation. The value 0 stops the animation.

Scale.Label: Pattern Scale
Scale.Hint: The size of the effect pattern. At 1, one pattern unit is one grid square.

OpenEditor.Label: Open Effect Editor
OpenEditor.NotCreated: Create the tile before you open the Effect Editor. Then open the configuration of the tile again.

HaloRadius.Label: Halo Size
HaloRadius.Hint: The size of the light around the painted area, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1.

HaloLight.Label: Halo Strength
HaloLight.Hint: The brightness of the light around the painted area.

CoreWhite.Label: Core Heat
CoreWhite.Hint: The quantity of white in the color of the painted area. A higher value gives a hotter center.

FlickerAmount.Label: Flicker
FlickerAmount.Hint: The strength of the changes in the light. The value 0 gives a steady glow.

Shininess.Label: Highlight Sharpness
Shininess.Hint: A higher value gives smaller and sharper highlights.

ShineBand.Label: Shine Band
ShineBand.Hint: The brightness of the moving band of light. The value 0 removes the band.

CameraMotion.Label: Camera Reflection
CameraMotion.Hint: The movement of the reflections when the camera moves. The value 0 keeps the reflections still.

ShadowTone.Label: Shadow Brightness
ShadowTone.Hint: The brightness of the metal on the darkest map areas. The value 1 gives a flat metal with no map tone.

WarpAmount.Label: Swirl Twist
WarpAmount.Hint: The twist of the liquid swirls. The value 0 gives soft clouds with no swirls.

Bands.Label: Rainbow Bands
Bands.Hint: The number of rainbow cycles in the film on the liquid.

FilmAmount.Label: Rainbow Strength
FilmAmount.Hint: The quantity of rainbow color on the liquid. The value 0 removes the rainbow.

Darken.Label: Liquid Brightness
Darken.Hint: The quantity of map brightness that stays in the liquid. A higher value shows more of the map.

Ripple.Label: Ripples
Ripple.Hint: The height of the small ripples on the surface.

RefractAmount.Label: Distortion
RefractAmount.Hint: The maximum shift of the map under the liquid, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1.

SpecularAmount.Label: Wet Highlights
SpecularAmount.Hint: The brightness of the wet highlights on the surface.

MoltenAmount.Label: Molten Area
MoltenAmount.Hint: The part of the surface that is molten. A low value gives mostly crust.

HeatLevel.Label: Heat Level
HeatLevel.Hint: The heat of the molten color. A higher value gives more yellow and white. This also sets the brightness of the light around the painted area.

CrustBrightness.Label: Crust Brightness
CrustBrightness.Hint: The quantity of map brightness in the crust. The value 0 gives a black crust.

WarpAmount.Label: Swirl
WarpAmount.Hint: The bend of the hot veins. The crust does not bend. The value 0 gives veins with no bend.

DetailAmount.Label: Surface Detail
DetailAmount.Hint: The roughness of the crust edges and the quantity of small veins. The value 0 gives smooth edges.

ReliefAmount.Label: Surface Relief
ReliefAmount.Hint: The height of the rough crust surface in the light. The value 0 gives a flat crust.

PulseAmount.Label: Heat Pulse
PulseAmount.Hint: The change of the molten heat with time. The crust shape does not change. The value 0 removes the pulse.

FlowAngle.Label: Flow Direction
FlowAngle.Hint: The flow direction in degrees. The direction turns with the tile.

FlowAmount.Label: Flow Speed
FlowAmount.Hint: The speed of the flow. The crust moves at half of this speed, as a solid piece. At the value 0, the crust stays still and the veins still change.

HeatRadius.Label: Heat Glow Size
HeatRadius.Hint: The size of the light around the painted area, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1. The value 0 removes the light.

DepthTint.Label: Deep Water Color
DepthTint.Hint: The quantity of effect color at the center of the water. The value 0 gives clear water.

ShoreWidth.Label: Shore Width
ShoreWidth.Hint: The distance from the edge of the painted area to the deep water, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1.

FoamAmount.Label: Foam
FoamAmount.Hint: The brightness of the foam at the edge of the painted area. The value 0 removes the foam.

CausticAmount.Label: Light Patterns
CausticAmount.Hint: The brightness of the light patterns on the bottom. The value 0 removes them.

WaveHeight.Label: Waves
WaveHeight.Hint: The height of the surface waves. The value 0 gives a flat surface.

RefractAmount.Label: Distortion
RefractAmount.Hint: The maximum shift of the map under the water, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1.

SpecularAmount.Label: Highlights
SpecularAmount.Hint: The brightness of the sun highlights on the waves.

FlowAngle.Label: Flow Direction
FlowAngle.Hint: The flow direction in degrees. The direction turns with the tile.

FlowAmount.Label: Flow Speed
FlowAmount.Hint: The speed of the flow. The value 0 gives a still pool.

FrostCover.Label: Frost Cover
FrostCover.Hint: The quantity of ice at full mask alpha. A lower value opens holes that fade slowly to the map. A very low value shows only thin cracks.

EdgeRoughness.Label: Edge Roughness
EdgeRoughness.Hint: The shift of the edge of the painted area, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1. The value 0 keeps the painted edge.

EdgeFade.Label: Edge Fade
EdgeFade.Hint: The width of the fade from the ice to the map at a hard edge of the painted area, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1. The value 0 gives a sudden edge.

FogRadius.Label: Fog Size
FogRadius.Hint: The distance of the fog from the border of the painted area, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1. The value 0 removes the fog.

FogAmount.Label: Fog Density
FogAmount.Hint: The density of the fog on the border of the painted area. The value 0 removes the fog.

FrostBlur.Label: Map Blur
FrostBlur.Hint: The blur radius of the map below the ice, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1. The value 0 removes the blur.

FrostTint.Label: Ice Color
FrostTint.Hint: The quantity of effect color in the ice. The value 0 gives clear ice.

RidgeAmount.Label: Cracks
RidgeAmount.Hint: The brightness of the cracks and scratches in the ice. The value 0 removes them.

SparkleAmount.Label: Sparkles
SparkleAmount.Hint: The brightness of the sparkles. The value 0 removes them.

ShineAmount.Label: Surface Shine
ShineAmount.Hint: The brightness of the soft reflections on the ice. They move slowly, and they also move with the camera. The value 0 removes them.

CurrentAmount.Label: Water Below
CurrentAmount.Hint: The strength of the water that moves below the ice. It also bends the map a little. The value 0 removes it.

FloeAmount.Label: Floating Ice
FloeAmount.Hint: The strength of the pieces of ice that float below the surface. The value 0 removes them.

StarDensity.Label: Star Quantity
StarDensity.Hint: The quantity of stars. The value 0 removes them.

TwinkleAmount.Label: Twinkle
TwinkleAmount.Hint: The change of the star brightness with time. The value 0 gives steady stars.

NebulaAmount.Label: Nebula
NebulaAmount.Hint: The brightness of the color clouds. The value 0 removes them.

DepthAmount.Label: Depth
DepthAmount.Hint: The movement of the stars when the camera moves. A higher value makes the void look deeper. The value 0 keeps the stars on the map.

RimRadius.Label: Rim Size
RimRadius.Hint: The size of the light around the painted area, in grid squares at Pattern Scale 1. The value 0 removes the light.

RimLight.Label: Rim Brightness
RimLight.Hint: The brightness of the light around the painted area. The value 0 removes the light.

Editor.Title: Effect Editor: Tile {id}
Editor.NoBackground: The scene has no background image.
Editor.CaptureFailed: Cannot load the scene background image. Look at the console for more data.
Editor.VideoNotSupported: Tile FX Painter cannot capture a video background.
Editor.ResetView: Reset View. Use the mouse wheel to zoom. To pan, hold Space and drag, or drag with the middle mouse button.
Editor.BrushHardness: Brush Hardness. A lower value gives a wider feathered edge.
Editor.BrushOpacity: Brush Opacity. One stroke does not go above this value. Paint again to add more.
Editor.ContiguousHint: Select only the pixels that connect to the pixel that you click. Clear this option to select all pixels with a near color.
Editor.PolygonHint: Click to add points. Double-click, press Enter, or click the first point to close. Press Escape to cancel.
Editor.SaveFailed: Cannot save the mask. Look at the console for more data.
Editor.InvalidDirectory: Cannot save the mask. The Mask Directory setting must be a directory in the User Data. Change the setting in the module settings.
Editor.LoadFailed: Cannot load the saved mask "{path}". The editor starts with an empty mask.
Editor.CopyFailed: Cannot copy the mask of the pasted tile. The new tile uses the mask file of the old tile, thus a save on the old tile also changes the new tile. Look at the console for more data.
Editor.CopyNoPermission: You do not have the permission to upload files. The pasted tile uses the mask file of the old tile, thus a save on the old tile also changes the new tile.
Editor.UnsavedContent: The mask has unsaved changes. Close the editor and discard the changes?

MaskDirectory.Name: Mask Directory
MaskDirectory.Hint: The directory in the User Data for the mask files of the Effect Editor. Other sources, for example Core Data and S3, do not work. The default directory stays after a module update. A module update or a reinstall can delete other directories in modules/tile-fx-painter/.
